text: Visitors have reported issues with finding the library, citing incorrect map locations and poor signage at nearby visitor centers, which has caused confusion and missed visits. The timed ticket system is not clearly communicated outside the website, leading to frustration among some guests who were turned away. Several reviews mention dissatisfaction with the gift shop’s merchandise, noting a lack of local North Dakota artists and an overreliance on AI-generated content. Customer service responsiveness has also been criticized, with at least one visitor describing difficulty in changing tickets and unhelpful AI assistance. Positive comments focus on the building’s architecture, interactive exhibits, and the surrounding landscape, but food quality and some interpretive elements received mixed feedback.
